fields.quote: Our performance quality assessment setup used the same evaluation pipeline for all the baselines to ensure a fair comparison, with the exception of MM1-3B-Chat.
fields.reason: Page 5 says the language-benchmark numbers use one pipeline, but page 12 explicitly excepts MM1-3B-Chat and states those scores were copied from published numbers because the model is unavailable. That is a same-harness rerun for most comparators and not for at least one, so rerun is MIXED rather than YES.

claims.reason: The abstract sentence reports that phi-3.5-MoE achieves superior benchmark performance versus similarly scaled open models. It does not state a new layer, attention, routing, or other architecture element as the authors' novelty, so it is not an ARCH/TRAIN contribution to keep.

This is the same performance introduction as A_only0: a 16x3.8B MoE with 6.6B active parameters that 'achieves' better results. Adopting top-2 MoE is described later as using a known design, not claimed as a new ARCH method, so keep=false.

The abstract only introduces phi-3.5-Vision as a 4.2B model derived from phi-3.5-mini that handles single- and multi-image prompts. That is a released-model capability statement, not an author-claimed novel architecture or training method.
